Introduction
The WARD-BECK Series St Stereophonic Production and Programming Consoles have been designed primarily to provide the broadcaster with maximum flexibility and comprehensive stereophonic facilities at moderate cost Configured in 24 and 36 channel versions, the Series ST Teleproduction Consoles offer legendary WARD-BECK performance and styling, while providing full stereophonic capabilities enhanced by a convenient, ergonomic control panel Layout
~ The 5T2442 Twenty-four Channel console provides twelve monaural mic/line mixing channels and twelve stereophonic Line mixing channels The larger St3642 Thirty-six Channel mainframe is available in versions with twelve monaural mic/line and twenty-four stereophonic Line channels; or twenty-four mic/line and twelve stereo line mixing channels. Both consoles are equipped with four stereo submasters, two stereo masters, and [wo independent monaural master outputs. Four Auxiliary outputs are also provided, assignable from all input channels and submasters. Each mic/line @ input channel is equipped for two mic and two Line inputs, and two stereo inputs are included with each stereo Line  mixing channel A versatile family of optional input preselectors permits substantial expansion of the input switching, with versions available to provide four or eight stereo Line inputs per channel  eight or sixteen mono Line inputs per channel or preselection from eight line or eight mic sources to a single input channel
Stereo and monaural channel equalization is provided in-line with each mixing channel and both mainframes are wired to accommodate a comprehensive family of additional audio processing devices accessible through the insertion/output jackfield standard on Series ST Consoles. Complete input patching may be included in these flexible consoles without increasing overall console size.
The Series ST consoles utilize the Msoo family of modules, a new generation of channel amplifiers, processors, monitoring, and output components integrating state of the art analog and microprocessor control technology , while achieving new standards of Perooghouce_ these ease consoles, oPerciudig Balanced Gnpd sircuseryions, utatieed uators, switching points 7 summing buses and outputs. Program outputs provide +30 dBm capability , and opti mal headroom and noise performance are maintained throughout the console signal path.
4 The console mainframes incorporate traditional WARD-BECK styling, and time-proven modular design techniques, and utilize all-metal construction for strength, durability , and long lasting appearance . 0
WBS
WBS Preservation Society
```

The standard microphone phantom power configuration is employed in St Series consoles. 48 Vdc is provided to the microphone input pair through two precision 6800 resistors. The M520 preamplifier provides a high-pass filter with three selectable frequencies. Depressing either of the two control pushbuttons provides a 12 dB/octave rol (-off, with the 3 dB point at 75 and 150 Hz respectively . Operation of both pushbuttons yields a roll-off at 225 Hz . Module response is flat with both pushbuttons released. An integral Program/Peak indication circuit is provided in the M520 Channel Amplifier. Solo routes the selected channel, in stereo, to the console Monitor 1 output, interrupting the signal selected at the Monitor Module.
